name: copy-vs-repeat-behavioral-probe-v1
status: FROZEN DRAFT -- awaiting human approval. No run has been made against this.
motivation: F162 found that phi-raising prefixes install the NEWLINE as a fixed point, and that the raising prefixes are newline-dense. That suggests the mechanism is COPYING: a model that strongly continues a repeated pattern will, under a prefix full of newlines, emit a newline and then keep emitting it -- which is exactly a fixed point of the argmax map. If so, a model's copy strength should predict which way its phi moves under a structured prefix, and copy strength is a BEHAVIOURAL quantity measurable without any census.

hypotheses.H1_copy_predicts_collapse: copy strength predicts phi-collapse under structured prefixes: models that copy strongly move phi toward the prefix's dominant token, models that copy weakly do not
hypotheses.H2_copy_is_the_missing_loading: BLOCKED ON F164, marked before running. This hypothesis ties copy strength to the model loading v of a bilinear fit, and that fit is NOT DECIDABLE (0.790 against a pre-registered 0.80, threshold unmoved). A loading from a fit that has not been licensed cannot serve as a criterion, so H2 is NOT EVALUATED in this run and no correlation against v is computed. Original text: 'copy strength correlates with the model loading v of a bilinear fit, should F164's coverage ever be filled -- i.e. copy strength IS the model-side factor the marginal searches missed.'

frozen.copy_estimator: induction-style copy score: for K=64 random token pairs (a,b) drawn from the same pool the census uses, build the context [a, b, ..., a] with a filler of F=8 random tokens between, and record whether argmax p(. | context) == b. copy_score = fraction of the K probes where it does. Deterministic given a seed; no sampling.
frozen.why_this_estimator: it measures the behaviour the mechanism needs -- continue a pattern seen earlier in context -- with one forward pass per probe and no reference to phi. It is NOT an induction-head circuit claim and no attention is inspected.
frozen.cohort: the eight models of results/domain_base.json, all of which already have raw and bos arms
frozen.phi_side: dphi under the structured arms already stored: F154 p1 (a table-of-contents fragment) and F155 t0..t5 (markup-density >= 0.15). No new census is needed for the phi side.
frozen.primary: sign agreement between copy_score rank and dphi rank across models on the p1 arm

kill_conditions.K1_copy_dead: copy_score does not separate the up-models from the down-models on the p1 arm -- i.e. the ranges overlap -- and the copy account is dropped
kill_conditions.K2_copy_lives: the up-models and down-models have disjoint copy_score ranges on the p1 arm, with at least 2 models on each side
kill_conditions.K3_vacuity: if fewer than 2 models fall on either side of the p1 split after the anti-vacuity gate, the comparison has no contrast: NOT DECIDABLE
kill_conditions.K4_ceiling: if copy_score is >= 0.95 or <= 0.05 on every model, the predictor has no variance and cannot discriminate: NOT DECIDABLE for predictor imbalance, the F163 defect
kill_conditions.K5_precision: ADDED 19 Aug 2026 after seeing ONE model's copy_score seed spread (pythia-410m: 0.469 / 0.609, range 0.14) and BEFORE any join to dphi. At K=64 the binomial SE is ~0.0625, so a raw min/max 'disjoint' test can separate two groups by noise alone. DISJOINTNESS IS THEREFORE JUDGED AGAINST THE PREDICTOR'S OWN NOISE: the gap between the up-group and down-group ranges must exceed 2 * the pooled across-seed SE of copy_score. If the groups separate on raw values but not beyond that noise, the verdict is NOT DECIDABLE FOR PRECISION -- not a pass -- and the fix is more probes (K), which is cheap, not a relaxed criterion.

anti_vacuity: a model enters only if its dphi on the p1 arm exceeds max(4/96, 2 * across-seed range) AND it had headroom on the side it moved. K4 additionally gates the PREDICTOR, because F163 showed a lopsided predictor produces a high raw agreement that is pure base rate.
refusals_recorded_before_numbers: no p-value: eight models cannot fail a significance test informatively
no rank correlation between copy_score and |dphi| -- eight clusters is below the ten-cluster floor this project uses, the F149 refusal
balanced accuracy, not raw accuracy, is reported for any two-class call, because F163 showed raw agreement to be a base-rate artefact at this cohort's class balance
note: The phi side is entirely existing data, so the only new compute is K=64 short forward passes per model -- cheaper than one census cell. If H1 survives it supplies the first MODEL-SIDE quantity in the programme that predicts a sign, which every marginal search from F147 to F156 failed to find; if it dies, it dies on a behavioural measurement rather than on an argument.
owed: the prior-art gate for induction heads and repetition self-reinforcement is OWED and is a precondition for writing this up, not a follow-up. The copy estimator is deliberately named 'induction-style' rather than 'induction head' because the circuit claim belongs to that literature and this probe does not test it.
amendment_log: 19 Aug 2026, BEFORE the run: H2 marked BLOCKED ON F164. F164's coverage gate was cleared by the fill (59% -> 74%) but its PRIMARY landed at 0.790 against 0.80 and stayed NOT DECIDABLE, so the loading v is not a licensed quantity. H1 is untouched and is what this run tests.

19 Aug 2026, BEFORE the run: recorded that F166 qualified F165 -- u_prefix is NOT 'which token the prefix selects' (best cross-model agreement on an arm's endpoint token is 4 of 9). The SURVIVING half is that, given a shared endpoint token, self-continuation is model-specific. H1 tests exactly that surviving half with an independent behavioural quantity, which is why this prereg is still live after F166.

19 Aug 2026, after one model, BEFORE any join: added K5_precision. The original disjointness test compared raw min/max with no reference to the predictor's own noise, which is the project's own defect class (a criterion with a shape on a quantity whose spread was never measured). Logged rather than silently applied.
